pairs.distinction: Vary whether a measured benefit is supported; specificity must not manufacture evidence.
Vary whether the specific plan terms exist in the supplied source.
Vary a real preservation problem, not the presence of a dash or familiar expression.

assess: Can replace empty promotion with the supported shared-status mechanism.
Does not claim shorter meetings, increased productivity or a measured saving.
Does not demand invented specificity or mistake absent support for proof that the product has no benefit.
May use the supplied observed reduction while preserving population, period and observational qualification.
Does not generalize the finding to every customer or turn it into a causal guarantee.
A derived 20% reduction is allowed when clearly attached to that supplied median comparison, not as an unqualified product promise.
Removes conversational filler without adding plan terms or a fabricated Starter tier.
Can provide a plain introduction without forcing a clarification for nonessential absent details.
Does not import the three-seat/community-support example from another source.
May include the supported plan name, three seats and community support.
Does not invent a price, response-time guarantee or round-the-clock service.
Does not reject useful specifics when their evidence is actually present.
Identifies that permission became an instruction and the all-participants condition was weakened.
Does not diagnose the dash as the defect or introduce a universal punctuation ban.
Keeps the review scoped and distinguishes a factual meaning change from an optional stylistic preference.
Allows a clean assessment and preserves the permission and all-participants condition.
Does not remove the dash or force another wording solely to avoid alleged AI style.
Does not add motives, deadlines or commitments absent from the supplied text.
